# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server, 2026-10-16: client-probes/probe_pronebones
# with probe_spot brecourt and probe_spawn_yaw 315 on mp_brecourt, one client
# holding prone at world yaw 270 from the join on. The first placement is a
# `spawn` on the spot at 315 with the view turned to 270 on the same frame,
# the second the usual setorigin a second later. Each PROBE bone line is a
# script_origin linked to that bone, read a frame after the pose it shows.
# The FALL lines are the client's snapshots, with `dir=` (proneDirection)
# on every prone one and the wire's legsAnim and torsoAnim.
